snippet.title: CRITICAL FAILURE (Cinematic Game Trailer)
snippet.description:
A cinematic game trailer for "CRITICAL FAILURE" , available on STEAM free to play. 

A story about the collapse of society and a virus that takes hold of the world. Only a few are left to fight back to save all of humanity, will "CRITICAL FUTURE", be to savior or will they but a "CRITICAL FAILURE", tune into an amazing series with twists and turns meant to leave you on the edge of your seat in this zombie apocalypse Sci-Fi Horror Series that is seemingly controlled by video games released on "STEAM" known as "CRITICAL FAILURE" and "CRITICAL FAILURE NO MAN'S LAND". Enjoy the games until the next episode.

CRITICAL FAILURE (FREE TO PLAY GAME) - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2610640/Critical_Failure/ .
